Kuc-kuc is an innovative service designed specifically to support older adults living alone in remote or rural areas, particularly during hazardous weather conditions. Its core purpose is to provide a reliable, automated safety check system that offers peace of mind to distant family members and caregivers by ensuring timely assistance when dangerous weather events such as heatwaves, frost, strong winds, or heavy snow are forecast. Unlike many modern solutions that rely on smartphones or apps, Kuc-kuc operates through landline phone calls, making it accessible to seniors who may not use or have access to advanced technology. Kuc-kuc is an automated service that monitors dangerous weather conditions and calls older adults living alone on their landline to check if they are safe. If there is no response or a sign of distress, it contacts a neighbor to physically check on them, providing reassurance to distant family members.

Kuc-kuc is currently in a pilot phase and does not publicly disclose pricing. Interested users should visit the official website or contact the developers for the latest information on availability and costs.
